description: YouTube Shorts 프롬프트 템플릿 (2026 트렌드 최적화)

veo_prompt_structure.formula: Subject + Action + Scene + Camera Movement + Lighting + Style + Audio

visual_styles.cinematic: cinematic color grading, shallow depth of field, film grain, 24fps motion blur
visual_styles.vibrant: high saturation, vivid colors, punchy contrast, HDR look
visual_styles.minimal: clean aesthetic, muted tones, minimalist composition, negative space
visual_styles.retro: vintage film look, warm color cast, light leaks, nostalgic feel
visual_styles.dark_moody: desaturated colors, deep shadows, atmospheric haze, noir inspired

question.description: 질문으로 시작하여 뇌가 자동으로 답을 찾게 함
question.visual: Close-up on intriguing object or face with questioning expression, slight camera push-in

examples: 99% of people don't know this about {topic}
I was today years old when I learned {fact}
shock.visual: High contrast dramatic shot, quick zoom or whip pan, bold text overlay

examples: Stop scrolling - you need to see this
direct_address.visual: Direct eye contact to camera, hand gesture pointing, breaking fourth wall

pattern_interrupt.visual: Jarring cut, unusual angle, unexpected color palette, visual contradiction

transformation.visual: Split screen or quick before/after cut, satisfying transition

educational.structure: Hook (0-3s) → Problem (3-10s) → Solution Steps (10-45s) → Result (45-55s) → CTA (55-60s)
educational.prompt_template:
Scene 1 (0-3s): {hook_visual}, close-up with dramatic lighting, immediate visual interest.
Scene 2 (3-10s): Wide shot establishing {problem_context}, slight camera movement, {mood} atmosphere.
Scene 3 (10-25s): Medium shot demonstrating {step_1}, smooth tracking shot, clear focus on action.
Scene 4 (25-40s): Close-up on {key_detail}, {camera_movement}, highlighting important element.
Scene 5 (40-55s): Reveal shot of {result}, pull-back to show full context, satisfying payoff.
Scene 6 (55-60s): Direct address or text overlay for CTA, warm inviting lighting.

Style: {visual_style}, 9:16 vertical, 4K quality
Audio: {audio_description}, clear narration, subtle background music

storytelling.prompt_template:
Scene 1 (0-3s): {opening_shot}, cinematic framing, {hook_element} to grab attention.
Scene 2 (3-15s): Establishing shot of {setting}, slow camera movement, {time_of_day} lighting, ambient sounds.
Scene 3 (15-25s): Medium shot of {character_action}, building tension, {mood} atmosphere.
Scene 4 (25-35s): Close-up reaction shot, emotional lighting, dramatic pause.
Scene 5 (35-50s): Wide shot {resolution_scene}, camera pulls back, triumphant or emotional music swell.
Scene 6 (50-60s): Final shot with {ending_visual}, fade or creative transition.

Style: {visual_style}, cinematic aspect within 9:16, film-like quality
Audio: Emotional score, natural ambient sounds, character dialogue: "{short_dialogue}"

aesthetic_vibes.structure: Visual Flow with Music (no narration needed)
aesthetic_vibes.prompt_template:
Scene 1 (0-8s): {opening_visual}, slow motion, {lighting_mood}, dreamy atmosphere.
Scene 2 (8-20s): {second_visual}, smooth dolly or crane shot, {color_palette} tones.
Scene 3 (20-35s): {third_visual}, creative camera angle, seamless transition from previous.
Scene 4 (35-50s): {fourth_visual}, dynamic movement, peak visual moment.
Scene 5 (50-60s): {closing_visual}, gentle fade or loop-friendly ending.

Style: {aesthetic_style}, highly polished, Instagram-worthy, ASMR-visual quality
Audio: {music_genre} beat, perfectly synced to visuals, no dialogue

tutorial_quick.prompt_template:
Scene 1 (0-3s): Close-up of {finished_result}, stunning presentation, hook the viewer with outcome.
Scene 2 (3-12s): Overhead shot of {materials_setup}, clean layout, soft even lighting.
Scene 3 (12-25s): POV or close-up of {step_1_action}, clear demonstration, {detail_focus}.
Scene 4 (25-38s): Medium shot of {step_2_action}, different angle, showing progress.
Scene 5 (38-50s): Close-up of {final_touches}, satisfying detail shots, near completion.
Scene 6 (50-60s): Beauty shot of {final_result}, slight rotation or movement, text overlay with key tip.

Style: Clean bright aesthetic, professional lighting, crisp focus
Audio: Upbeat background music, clear step-by-step narration, satisfying sound effects

reaction_commentary.prompt_template:
Scene 1 (0-2s): Screen recording or reference to {original_content}, attention-grabbing moment.
Scene 2 (2-20s): Face cam reaction shot, expressive {emotion}, natural lighting, engaged body language.
Scene 3 (20-35s): Split screen or picture-in-picture, {commentary_visual}, dynamic framing.
Scene 4 (35-50s): Full frame reaction, {peak_emotion_moment}, camera slightly closer.
Scene 5 (50-60s): Direct address to camera, {call_to_action}, friendly inviting expression.

Style: Authentic vlog aesthetic, good audio quality, personality-forward
Audio: Clear voice, reaction sounds, optional background music low in mix

dialogue_rules: Keep dialogue under 8 seconds per scene
Use colon format: 'Character says: dialogue here' to avoid auto-subtitles
Match lip movements to short, clear phrases
music_sync: Use trending sounds in first 5 seconds for 21% reach boost
Beat drops should align with visual transitions
Music energy should match content energy curve
sound_design: Add satisfying sound effects for actions (ASMR-style)
Silence can be powerful for dramatic moments

first_3_seconds: Face visible (42% engagement boost) if applicable
No slow build or context setup
retention_tactics: Loop-friendly ending (last frame connects to first)

tech_review.lighting: clean studio lighting, subtle rim light
tech_review.camera: smooth product shots, macro details, rotating display
tech_review.style: modern minimal, tech aesthetic, blue accent colors

food_recipe.camera: overhead shots, close-up textures, steam rising
food_recipe.style: cozy warm tones, rustic elements, appetizing colors
food_recipe.audio: cooking ASMR sounds, light acoustic music

fitness.camera: dynamic tracking, slow-mo impacts, multiple angles
fitness.audio: pump-up beats, breathing sounds, impact effects

travel.camera: drone shots, gimbal walks, epic reveals

comedy_skit.camera: static setup with reaction cuts, comedic timing
comedy_skit.audio: comedic timing beats, sound effects for punchlines

motivation.camera: epic wide shots, powerful low angles, slow push-ins

asmr_satisfying.style: clean minimal, pleasing symmetry, color harmony
asmr_satisfying.audio: crisp detailed sounds, no music, pure ASMR

nature_relaxation.camera: slow cinematic pans, time-lapses, macro nature

example_prompts.sunset_relaxation:
Scene 1 (0-3s): Breathtaking close-up of sun touching ocean horizon, golden hour light reflecting on gentle waves, slow camera tilt up.
Scene 2 (3-15s): Wide cinematic shot of beach silhouette, palm trees swaying, warm orange and purple sky, smooth dolly right.
Scene 3 (15-30s): Medium shot of waves washing over sand, foam patterns, golden backlight, relaxing rhythm.
Scene 4 (30-45s): Close-up of seashells and sand details, soft focus background, intimate perspective.
Scene 5 (45-60s): Final wide shot as sun dips below horizon, stars beginning to appear, gentle fade.

Style: Cinematic film look, warm color grading, 9:16 vertical, dreamy soft focus
Audio: Gentle ocean waves, distant seagulls, soft ambient piano melody
example_prompts.coffee_morning:
Scene 1 (0-3s): Extreme close-up of coffee being poured into ceramic cup, steam rising dramatically, rich brown colors, macro lens detail.
Scene 2 (3-12s): Pull back to reveal cozy morning scene, soft window light streaming in, warm bokeh background, smooth camera movement.
Scene 3 (12-25s): Overhead shot of hands wrapping around warm cup, cream swirling into coffee, satisfying spiral pattern.
Scene 4 (25-40s): Medium shot of peaceful morning moment, steam wisps catching light, relaxed atmosphere.
Scene 5 (40-55s): Close-up of first sip, content expression, warm inviting feeling.
Scene 6 (55-60s): Wide shot of complete cozy scene, text overlay: 'Start your day right', loop-friendly ending.

Style: Warm cozy aesthetic, soft natural lighting, hygge vibes, film grain
Audio: Coffee pouring ASMR, gentle morning ambience, soft lo-fi beat
example_prompts.space_exploration:
Scene 1 (0-3s): Dramatic reveal of Earth from space, sun cresting the horizon, lens flare, epic scale immediately apparent.
Scene 2 (3-15s): Sweeping camera move past space station, stars in background, Earth reflection on solar panels, zero gravity feel.
Scene 3 (15-30s): Close-up of astronaut helmet visor, Earth reflection visible, human element in vast space.
Scene 4 (30-45s): Pull back to show astronaut floating, nebula colors in distance, sense of wonder and scale.
Scene 5 (45-60s): Final wide shot of galaxy, zoom into stars, infinite possibility feeling.

Style: Cinematic sci-fi, deep blacks and vibrant nebula colors, epic scale, 4K detail
Audio: Hans Zimmer style orchestral, deep bass, ethereal choir, no dialogue
